description: Two multi-query searches covered November overall, English/Setswana terms, split early/late month with national regional/sector terms, and local outlet domains. Search index was noisy and exposed few in-country gathering leads; one timely Patriot page on truckers was opened and did not document a collective public assembly. No verified November candidate found. Women, pensioners, regional gatherings and exact dates remain partial; Namibia cross-border BDF protests were explicitly excluded by territory/target scope.
required_followup: Search local/regional dated reporting for Gaborone, Francistown, Maun, Palapye and other regions, by women, pensioners, students and workers, and check state-policy/public-action evidence.
